query: How can clinics improve triage and scheduling?

per_column.name: estimated_resource_intensity
per_column.rationale: Resource intensity of a case is a common cause: it drives how a case might be scheduled/handled and also affects triage/scheduling efficiency. It is a case property, not an actor-set lever, so it is not a clean intervenable treatment; better read as a confounder. Not named in the query.

per_column.name: follow_up_required
per_column.rationale: Whether follow-up is required is largely an outcome/consequence of the visit and its handling rather than a common cause of an intervenable treatment and efficiency. It is a downstream property, not a confounder or a settable lever.

per_column.name: specialist_referral_needed
per_column.rationale: Whether a specialist referral is needed is a clinical property determined by the case; it lies on the pathway between case handling and scheduling outcomes rather than being a pre-treatment common cause. Not a confounder and not an intervenable treatment.

per_column.name: has_comorbidity
per_column.rationale: Comorbidity is a genuine pre-existing patient trait that plausibly influences both case complexity/handling and triage/scheduling efficiency. It is a valid common-cause confounder, and it is not named in the query. However, it is an immutable patient attribute, not a settable treatment.

judge.rationale: The query poses an interventional 'how can clinics improve' question, so a valid what-if augmentation needs (a) an intervenable treatment lever (e.g., staffing level, triage protocol, appointment slot policy, walk-in vs booked assignment) and (b) confounders to adjust for. NO added column is an actor-settable lever: estimated_resource_intensity, has_comorbidity are case/patient properties, while follow_up_required and specialist_referral_needed are downstream consequences/mediators. Thus the core requirement -- an intervenable treatment -- is absent, so the interventional claim is not realised. Some columns (has_comorbidity, arguably resource intensity) function as plausible unnamed confounders, showing partial confounder capability, but without a treatment there is nothing to intervene on and the counterfactual effect cannot be set up.
